name: twilio
description: Send SMS and read messages/calls with Twilio (Basic auth via secretHeaders). Load for sending SMS and reading message logs. Sending SMS is a real, billable action - confirm intent.

content.inline:
## Twilio
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01` with `secretHeaders: {"Authorization": "s/TWILIO_AUTH"}`. Store the secret as the complete header value `Basic <base64 of AccountSID:AuthToken>` (from console.twilio.com; base64-encode `ACxxxx:your_auth_token`). Request bodies are form-encoded. Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common calls (`{SID}` is your Account SID, `ACxxxx`):
- Account: `GET /Accounts/{SID}.json`
- Send SMS: `POST /Accounts/{SID}/Messages.json` form body `To=%2B1555...&From=%2B1555...&Body=Hello` (numbers in E.164, `+` encoded as `%2B`)
- List messages: `GET /Accounts/{SID}/Messages.json?PageSize=50`
- One message: `GET /Accounts/{SID}/Messages/{MessageSid}.json`
- List calls: `GET /Accounts/{SID}/Calls.json?PageSize=50`

Rules:
- Check `status`; errors are `{code, message, more_info}`. 401 = bad credentials; 21211 = invalid `To` number.
- Sending SMS costs money and reaches a real phone - confirm `To`, `From`, and `Body` with the user first. `From` must be a number you own on the account.
